description: Get B2b Invoices. Part of the Invoices APIs in Giddh. Requires Auth-Key or Session-Id.

branchUniqueName.description: Branch uniqueName; omit for default company branch behaviour. Optional.

count.description: Page size (number of items returned). Default: 20. Optional.

action.description: Action to perform. Default: NOT_ON_GIDDH. Optional.

refresh.description: When true, bypass cache and recompute. Default: false. Optional.

gstReturnType.description: Gst return type query parameter. Optional.

gsp.description: Gsp query parameter. Default: whitebooks. Optional.
